messages.subject: dataProcess errors (Skyline to MSstats) MIBs
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to process MIBs data that have been converted to MSstats format from Skyline format, but I get the following error:


But when I look at the data, I don't see how the data have duplicate rows because the intensities are always different (There are proteins with multiple rows of the same peptide, but these peptides are from different runs/samples, with different conditions, different intensities). So then I found that only certain features must be unique, so I removed rows that had duplicate values in those features using distinct():
Skyfiltered.data <- distinct(Skyfiltered.data, Proteinname, PeptideSequence,PrecursorCharge,Fragmentation,ProductCharge,IsotopeLabelType,.keep_all=TRUE)

And then when I tried to process data with this data set, I got a different error:
Can't summarize for   ( x  of  91 ) because features have only one measurement across MS runs.

Does anyone know how to resolve this issue or have any advice? Thank you.

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: dataProcess errors (Skyline to MSstats) MIBs
parts:
As you noted, the error message about duplicate row is related to feature. There should be only one measurement for a feature in one run. The message "Can't summarize for..." you got seems to be caused by the way you called the distinct() function, where only one single measurement would be kept across runs. It should resolve your issue by calling distinct() as below: 

Skyfiltered.data <- Skyfiltered.data %>% 
    distinct(ProteinName, PeptideSequence, PrecursorCharge, FragmentIon, ProductCharge, IsotopeLabelType, Run, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
    as.data.frame()
